const question = $json.question || "";

const query = `
MATCH (n)
WHERE
  n:Material
  OR (
    n:Actor AND (
      toLower(coalesce(n.actor_name, n.name, "")) CONTAINS "recycling"
      OR toLower(coalesce(n.actor_name, n.name, "")) CONTAINS "recovery"
      OR toLower(coalesce(n.actor_name, n.name, "")) CONTAINS "waste"
      OR toLower(coalesce(n.actor_name, n.name, "")) CONTAINS "environment"
      OR toLower(coalesce(n.actor_name, n.name, "")) CONTAINS "sustainability"
    )
  )
  OR any(k IN keys(n) WHERE 
    toLower(k) CONTAINS "carbon"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "co2"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "emission"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "recycling"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "recycled"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "waste"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "environment"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "sustainability"
  )
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(connected)
RETURN
  coalesce(
    n.material_id,
    n.actor_id,
    n.unit_id,
    n.process_id,
    n.location_code,
    n.id
  ) AS item_id,
  labels(n)[0] AS item_type,
  coalesce(
    n.material_name,
    n.actor_name,
    n.name,
    n.process_name,
    n.location_name,
    n.serial_number,
    n.id
  ) AS item_name,
  properties(n) AS properties,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  labels(connected) AS connected_labels,
  coalesce(
    connected.actor_name,
    connected.name,
    connected.unit_id,
    connected.process_id,
    connected.process_name,
    connected.material_name,
    connected.location_name,
    connected.id
  ) AS connected_entity
LIMIT 100
`;

return [
  {
    json: {
      agent: "sustainability_analyst",
      domain: "Sustainability Analyst",
      question,
      query,
      params: {},
    },
  },
];
